author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
On my Muse.ai free account, generate 300 images (of anime girls) used around 50% of my weekly tokens limit

On my Gemini app, generate 10 images of anime girl used up all my 5 hours limit and 5% of my weekly limit, so I can generate 200 images of anime girls a week.

I propose we use number of anime girls image generated to measure the tokens efficiency of different AI labs.
